summary: GT Biopharma filed an 8-K reporting that on September 22, 2026, Nasdaq notified the company it regained compliance with the $1.00 minimum bid price requirement under Listing Rule 5550(a)(2). The deficiency began November 20, 2025, after 30 consecutive sub-$1.00 closes; Nasdaq granted a 180-day extension on May 20, 2026, to November 16, 2026. Compliance was achieved by maintaining a closing bid above $1.00 for at least ten consecutive business days. No terms, advisor, or board recommendation were disclosed. Watch for renewed sub-$1.00 closes and any reverse-split or capital-raise response.
